name: online-forever
description: Keep a Discord user account showing as online (or idle / DND) by holding a gateway connection. Based on SealedSaucer/Online-Forever. There is no web UI.

variables.name: Discord Token
variables.description: Your Discord user token. Never share this. Anyone with it can use your account.

variables.name: Status
variables.description: Presence status: online, idle, dnd, or invisible.

variables.name: Custom Status
variables.description: Custom status text shown on your Discord profile. Leave empty to disable.

variables.name: Use Emoji
variables.description: Set to true to attach an emoji to the custom status.

variables.name: Emoji Name
variables.description: Unicode emoji or custom emoji name used when Use Emoji is true.

variables.name: Emoji Animated
variables.description: Set to true for an animated custom emoji.

variables.name: Reconnect Delay
variables.description: Seconds to wait before reconnecting after a dropped gateway session.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: The timezone for the container (e.g., Europe/London). Affects log timestamps.
